description: As a dedicated service for travelers in Korea, Hanatour helps users easily search and compare special offer flights and a curated selection of travel packages directly within a ChatGPT conversation. By providing optimal options based on destination, schedule, preferred airlines, and specific travel themes such as golf or honeymoons, the app allows users to quickly plan trips that fit their budget and purpose without the hassle of browsing multiple pages. Now, you can make simpler and smarter travel decisions through a single, seamless conversational experience powered by Hanatour’s consolidated information.
